ops.title: cc-transcript main red Nov 2: root causes and fixes (#176-#181)
ops.body:
Main CI was red from #150 (f5d443f) until #181 (2e39ad7, released as v14.46.10). Earlier failing steps hid later ones, so each fix exposed the next failure. Root causes:
- #164 (1074e06) removed agent requests' maximum-sized reply reservation and their origin, prefix and seal fence reads. Two agent_codex tests still assumed both. #176 fixed the tests: evict cache owners before an exact hold, and swap the parent on the single suffix read.
- #150 ActivityIndex over-charge: a continued turn charged its calls metadata a second time, and Vector/Tree::bytes_since used imbl ptr_eq, which is false for cloned inline vectors. #177 fixed the code: subtract shared calls metadata, and compare metadata Arc identity.
- #150 made generic (non-agent) loads cold on purpose. Generic files are mutable, and the 64-byte fence misses interior rewrites; restoring spine reuse (#178, closed) broke 8 #150 tests. #179 fixed the stale hydration and shared-publication tests. The shared publication control script also runs that test file against c001a9d, so the file must pass on pre-#150 code.
- #150 added an early return in parse_tool_call that let unserializable non-mapping inputs raise under on_error='other'. #180 fixed it.
- #159's Linux wheel smoke ran `uv build` (sdist first, which drops the untracked owner data dir). #181 fixed it with `uv build --wheel`.
CI bisect pattern: branch per commit with a minimal ci.yml, then `gh workflow run ci.yml --ref <branch>`. ci.yml's pull_request trigger only covers base main, so stacked PRs need workflow_dispatch to get CI.
